pages.text: "Broth on Ddori's cheek!" Bung took a towel. Morning stove smoke rose. The rope round the post was taut. Their boat stayed still today too.
"I will wash Ddori!" Bung held a hand toward Mom. She scooped water from the big bucket and set it before Bung.
Bung scrubbed Ddori's cheek with the wet towel. Ddori shook the head, little hands pushing Bung away.
"Stay still!" Bung pulled Ddori's arm sharply. Ddori covered a cheek, pushed away the towel, and crawled off to sit.
Mom hugged Ddori first and blew gently on the cheek. Returning, she laid her hand lightly over Bung's. Under it, Bung's hand moved very slowly.
"Like this. Gentle with baby hands." Under Mom's guidance, Bung's hand slid gently. Bung watched their joined hands. "Gentle with baby hands..."
Bung wet the towel again and gently wiped Ddori's cheek. Ddori shut the eyes and stayed still. The tied boat did not rock. "Gentle with baby hands!" Bung's voice was soft.
Bung gently drew Ddori's hand close and cleaned each finger. Ddori held out the other hand too.
"Mm." Ddori sat on Bung's knees. "One, gentle with baby hands! Two, wait instead of pulling! Three, towel pats!" Bung spread three fingers.
Mom softly laid Bung's hand on Ddori's. A relaxed hand was kindest. Cheek against Ddori's, Bung said, "Gentle with baby hands!"
